data_description.display_id: Display ID reported by the display (often 0 or 1).
data_description.host: Host or IP address of the display.
data_description.pin: 4-digit PIN for secured TLS (if enabled on the display).

set_ticker.description: Update ticker text and configuration on the display. Omitted fields reuse the current ticker configuration. Target the ticker sensor or display device, or provide a config entry.

background_color.description: Ticker background color. Uses the current value when omitted.
background_color.name: Background color

background_opacity.description: Ticker background opacity. Uses the current value when omitted.
background_opacity.name: Background opacity

config_entry_id.description: Samsung MDC config entry ID. Only needed when not targeting a ticker sensor.
config_entry_id.name: Config entry

device_id.description: Samsung MDC display device. Only needed when not targeting a ticker sensor.
device_id.name: Device

end_time.description: End time in HH:MM. Defaults to about one to two minutes after start time based on message length.
end_time.name: End time

font_size.description: Ticker font size. Uses the current value when omitted.
font_size.name: Font size

foreground_color.description: Ticker foreground color. Uses the current value when omitted.
foreground_color.name: Foreground color

foreground_opacity.description: Ticker foreground opacity. Uses the current value when omitted.
foreground_opacity.name: Foreground opacity

message.description: Ticker message text. Uses the current value when omitted.
message.name: Message

motion_dir.description: Ticker movement direction. Uses the current value when omitted.
motion_dir.name: Motion direction

motion_on.description: Enable ticker motion. Uses the current value when omitted.
motion_on.name: Motion enabled

motion_speed.description: Ticker movement speed. Uses the current value when omitted.
motion_speed.name: Motion speed

on.description: Turn ticker on. Uses the current value when omitted.
on.name: Enabled

pos_horiz.description: Horizontal ticker position. Uses the current value when omitted.
pos_horiz.name: Horizontal position

pos_verti.description: Vertical ticker position. Uses the current value when omitted.
pos_verti.name: Vertical position

start_time.description: Start time in HH:MM. Defaults to a few seconds from now when omitted or in the past.
start_time.name: Start time

set_ticker.name: Set ticker
